verdict.rationale: The product's own marketing lists "Pagamentos em lote" (batch payments), a first-party bulk operation, but it appears only as a one-line feature mention, and the API docs describe only per-item operations plus paginated list filtering. Paginated listing reads many items but does not act on them in bulk. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk actions beyond payments (e.g., cards, categorization, reconciliation), detail on how batch payments work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
